operator: 11/19 (screenshot of STM / SMCI / NVDA / GOOGL / GOOG / HOOD / AEHR / CGON / GTLB) 'how about those trending up with low heat' -> '"Low heat isn't a buy signal on this desk" - can we test it?'
idea: Buy a name that is up on the day while its heat is LOW and turning up - early in the next push, before it reaches the pre-square buy zone. Related prior tests: pitch_entries (both 1-min %R lines turning up = random minute, 10/27), oversold_leave (FAIL 10/15), pullback family (FAIL 10/30). Those used different universes, lines or thresholds; this one uses the dashboard's own heat reading on the desk's admission band.
heat: the dashboard heat = 100 + fast %R (21, EWM 7) on 1-minute bars with the prior session's last 112 bars prepended (evening_family.minute_grid + bar_signal_family.wr_smoothed, as in presquare_bars); 'rising' = heat up > 0.05 vs the previous bar
universe: warehouse SIP top-400 by prior-day dollar volume, ETFs/ETPs excluded; at the trigger bar price $20-$400 and up >= 1.5% vs prior close (the desk's admission band)
trigger: LOW-HEAT TURN at bar t in 15..330: heat < 40 on bar t, heat rising on bar t AND on bar t-1, and not rising on bar t-2 (the second rising bar of a new turn). Per name a 30-minute refractory.

exits (2 cells, Bonferroni).desk: holistic_entry.bracket: +20 bp before -50 bp within 15 min
exits (2 cells, Bonferroni).hold: close of the 15:55 bar with a -3% stop (morning_picks_hold.exit_main logic from the entry bar)

cost: real SIP quoted spread in the 60 s before entry (news_source.fetch_quotes); spread > 15 bp not traded (the live gate); net = gross - spread
sample: <= 4,000 triggers per period by the lowest sha256('lhr'|day|sym|t); both exits scored on the same entries

pass_each.both_halves: mean net > 0 in both date halves of DECIDE

information_only: (a) a random bar 15..330 on the same name-day (seed sha256('lhr_r'|day|sym)) with the same exits - lift vs control; (b) the desk's pre-square triggers on the same days (what it buys today); (c) heat < 25 vs 25-40; (d) day change 1.5-3% vs > 3%; (e) time of day; (f) triggers per 10 minutes after the gate
if_pass: result-skeptic review, then a default-off arm that buys a low-heat turn on admitted names (normal gates), replayed through the live code, on paper under the operator's 11/18 rule
if_fail: record; buying low heat turning up on up-day names does not pay at these exits after real spreads
